rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for things connected with medical practice or healthcare services.

example.english: The medical services at this hospital are quite comprehensive.
example.traditional: 呢間醫院嘅醫療服務幾全面。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 ji1 jyun2 ge3 ji1 liu4 fuk6 mou6 gei2 cyun4 min6

rows.note: Use this for health-related matters, such as health checks or health records, rather than medical treatment itself.

example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 hai6 ngo5 ge3 gin6 hong1 gei2 luk6

rows.note: Use this when the item is intended for medicinal or therapeutic use.

example.english: This herbal plant is for medical use.
example.traditional: 呢種草本植物係藥用嘅。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung2 cou2 bun2 zik6 mat6 hai6 joek6 jung6 ge3

rows.note: Use this when a condition or person specifically needs medical treatment.

example.english: That cut of yours is so deep; it needs medical treatment.
example.traditional: 你呢個傷口咁深，要醫嘅喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 ni1 go3 soeng1 hau2 gam3 sam1 jiu3 ji1 ge3 wo3
